content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm building an application involving a [product_name] and a [product_name] panel, but I can't manage to keep variable values after powering down the panel—they always reset to zero. Could someone advise on how to maintain retentive variables in this setup?
Hi, could you clarify which variable you are using in the panel? When you switch off the power, is it only the panel or is the [product_name] device also powered down?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing trouble with variable values resetting after the [product_name] panel loses power, indicating a lack of persistence. This points to either a missing configuration or limitation with retentive variables in their system, and raises concerns about reliably preserving application state.
analysis.user_expectations: User wants the system to remember and restore variable values even after the panel has been powered off and back on, ensuring consistent application state across power cycles.
